title: Best AI Support Tools for WhatsApp Business
intro: WhatsApp is where a lot of support conversations already happen, especially outside the US — the question is whether your tool treats it as a first-class channel or a bolted-on integration. These three build around it directly.

entries.blurb: WhatsApp is one of ManyChat's three core channels alongside Instagram and Messenger, with the same visual flow builder driving all three — though Meta's own WhatsApp messaging fees apply on top of ManyChat's plan pricing.
Unifies WhatsApp with web chat, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, and email in one shared inbox, which matters if your team is fielding WhatsApp alongside other channels rather than exclusively.

An AI Employee deployed specifically into WhatsApp automations can read and update contact fields mid-conversation, not just reply to messages — useful if WhatsApp is your primary channel rather than a secondary one.
